M6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The oracle in M2 is an upper bound, not a model. It has seen every label and it is
still capped, which is the point, but no real gene-blind scorer would reach it.
A ceiling explains why a gene-blind stack cannot win. It does not explain why the
sequence columns lost to a dinucleotide shuffle in loop 173, which is a separate
failure and is not rescued by anything here.
The many-to-many structure is partly an artefact of which pairs the screens chose to
test. An element tested against one gene only is not thereby specific to it.
